noncomputable def VTask.strongDownwardInduction {α : Type u_1} {p : Finset α → Sort u_4} {n : ℕ} 
    (H : (t₁ : Finset α) → ({t₂ : Finset α} → t₂.card ≤ n → t₁ ⊂ t₂ → p t₂) → t₁.card ≤ n → p t₁)
    (s : Finset α) (hs : s.card ≤ n) : p s :=
match s with
| ∅ => H ∅ (fun h _ => absurd h (by omega)) hs
| s' =>

    else none
  match findSome f with
  | some v => v
  | none => absurd hs (by linarith [le_trans hs (card_le_of_subset_le_card s' s)])
